Test a more robust DBA combination to see if iterative optimization improves over mean in this trend‑dominated, unstable‑ranking series.
test a per-horizon softmax weighting on the full pool to see if horizon‑specific calibration helps in this trend‑dominated, unstable‑ranking series.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings, so a robust trimmed mean over a correlated‑error subset (pool4) may outperform the full‑pool means.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings; a robust, non‑weighted aggregation like median may improve robustness over mean/weighted combos.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings; a per‑horizon weighted combo may capture horizon‑specific best models and improve over robust mean/median.
Test a weighted combination on the smaller, more stable pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if focusing on best models improves over median.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable rankings; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of extreme errors.
The series has an unstable ranking and strong trend; a softmax-based weighting may give more balanced influence than inverse_error on the reduced pool4.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings; a robust DBA over a smaller, more complementary pool may improve over the current median.
test a per‑horizon weighted mean (top‑k per horizon) on the full pool to see if horizon‑specific agreement improves the robust trend‑dominated series.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9848. Series context: trend strength 0.9425 and seasonal strength 0.133; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.057); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.802.
